definition: An oscillatory neural network (ONN) is an artificial neural network that uses coupled oscillators as neurons.
details: Oscillatory neural networks are closely linked to the Kuramoto model, and are inspired by the phenomenon of neural oscillations in the brain. Oscillatory neural networks have been trained to recognize images. Complex-Valued Oscillatory network has also been shown to store and retrieve multidimensional aperiodic signals. An oscillatory autoencoder has also been demonstrated, which uses a combination of oscillators and rate-coded neurons. A neuron made of two coupled oscillators, one having a fixed and the other having a tunable natural frequency, has been shown able to run logic gates such as XOR that conventional sigmoid neurons cannot.

explainer.lead: An oscillatory neural network is an artificial neural network that uses coupled oscillators as neurons. It is closely linked to the Kuramoto model and inspired by neural oscillations in the brain.

tiers.eli5: Instead of switches that turn on and off, it uses things that rhythmically pulse, and the way those pulses fall into step carries the information.
tiers.practitioner: Such networks have been trained to recognize images, and a complex-valued oscillatory network has stored and retrieved multidimensional aperiodic signals. An oscillatory autoencoder has also been demonstrated combining oscillators and rate-coded neurons; a pitfall is that the design space mixes unfamiliar components such as coupled-oscillator neurons.
tiers.paperLevel: An artificial neural network using coupled oscillators as neurons, closely linked to the Kuramoto model and inspired by neural oscillations in the brain; complex-valued oscillatory networks store and retrieve multidimensional aperiodic signals, and an oscillatory autoencoder combines oscillators and rate-coded neurons.

explainer.example: An oscillatory network is trained to recognize images, with each coupled-oscillator neuron contributing through its phase relationship to the others.
